description.value: Shavasana Art Gallery & Café is a combined art gallery and café perched on a promontory at the edge of 'The Village' on Mayne Island, with views of Active Pass. The café offers coffee, a reported 23 varieties of tea, and locally baked cookies and squares alongside rotating exhibitions of local and regional artists running May through October. Described as one of only about seven things to do on Mayne Island, it's a distinctive cultural stop for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands.
